CAMPAIGN_INCOMPLETE: NO SENTENCE IS PERMITTED. The campaign has not run to the preregistered repetitions, which is not one of the five section 6 classifications and must not be reported as any of them.
INAPPLICABLE: The fix-preserving GNSS position offset required to exercise the history-dominated threshold-crossing mechanism cannot be applied on this platform, so the mechanism was not tested there.
No substitute intervention was run, because substituting one would test a different fault.
INCONCLUSIVE: The Mechanism B campaign ran on this platform but its validity controls failed, so no claim is made about the history-dominated threshold-crossing mechanism there.
NOT_REPLICATED: On ArduPilot 4.8 the source recursion does not reproduce the runtime trust trajectory within the preregistered tolerance, so the history-dominated threshold-crossing mechanism does not replicate on the current stack.
This is an external-validity finding about a mechanism derived from a single 2015-era autopilot.
PARTIALLY_REPLICATED: On ArduPilot 4.8 the source recursion reproduces the runtime trust trajectory to within the preregistered tolerance, but the crossing outcomes do not match the predeclared expectation for every condition.
The recursion is therefore confirmed as the mechanism governing the trajectory; the conditions under which it reaches a threshold are not fully characterised on this platform.
REPLICATED: The history-dominated threshold-crossing mechanism replicates on ArduPilot 4.8: given the platform's own measured banked state and its measured per-tick evidence and forgetting factor, the source recursion reproduces the runtime trust trajectory and predicts the observed threshold crossing.
The crossing tick differs from the 2015 ArduCopter 3.3 figure because the banked state differs; the mechanism, not the number, is what replicates.
